sloka: हनूमता वेगवता वानरेण महात्मना ।लङ्कापुरं प्रदग्धं तद्रुद्रेण त्रिपुरं यथा ।। 5.54.31 ।।।।
transliteration: hanūmatā vegavatā vānareṇa mahātmanā ।laṅkāpuraṁ pradagdhaṁ tadrudreṇa tripuraṁ yathā ।। 5.54.31 ।।।।

translations.english: The fierce fire lit by Hanuman, the hero endowed with great speed, spread around in circles and shot up flying high to the top of the Trikuta mountain on which Lanka was located.
